description: Full_Name column stores personal full names as free‑text strings. It contains 30 distinct, non‑null values with no missing entries. The data includes a variety of cultural naming conventions (e.g., "Bin", "Binte", "s/o", "d/o") and exhibits mixed capitalization, such as all‑lowercase names like "junrong" and "irfan" alongside title‑cased names.
